articles.제목: KHNP ends negotiations with construction consortium for Czech units
articles.원문 요약: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power is to select a new contractor for the construction of two APR1000 reactors at the Czech Republic's Dukovany nuclear power plant following the collapse of contract negotiations with the Daewoo-Doosan consortium.

articles.제목: Germany narrows search for radioactive waste repository location
articles.원문 요약: The Federal Company for Radioactive Waste Disposal said that in the past year it has reduced the area that it is considering in the site selection procedure for Germany's planned high-level radioactive waste repository from 25% of the country's territory to less than 5%.

articles.제목: Antares, BWXT in TRISO fuel procurement deal
articles.원문 요약: The commercial agreement covers an initial tonne of TRISO fuel for Antares Nuclear's microreactors, which could be increased as deployment requirements evolve to support Antares's advanced reactor programme.

articles.제목: Westinghouse to conduct key study for AP1000 in Slovakia
articles.원문 요약: Westinghouse is to carry out a Front-End Engineering and Design study for the potential deployment of an AP1000 reactor at the Bohunice Nuclear Power Plant in the Slovak Republic.

articles.제목: Turkish oil refiner to consider SMR deployment
articles.원문 요약: TÜPRAŞ, Turkey's largest crude oil refiner, has signed an agreement with the US Trade and Development Agency to fund technical assistance to assess the potential of small modular reactors to supply electricity, heat and steam for its refining processes.
